description: Upgrade a legacy (v1 folder-layout) vault to v2 in one commit of remote tip bytes, then Save a dirty working copy as a second commit under the same confirmation. Requires confirm: true. Never runs on load. On v2 returns already_upgraded. Success is a summary: status, commit SHAs, assemblyIds, counts, leftoverFiles paths, and warnings — not the full plan, file contents, meshes, partBindings paths, or rekey.scripts. Takes return: "status" | "summary" | "full" (MCP default "status": status.script is omitted; "summary" adds status.features; "full" echoes the script).

return.description: How much of status to return: "status" drops status.script, "summary" drops it and adds status.features (the feature strip), "full" keeps the whole script. Over MCP the default is "status"; in the page it is "full". Read the script with get_script.

name: git_upgrade_vault
